items.title: Approve an increase of 219 calendar days for Contract No. WD-2873(I), 525 Golden Gate Avenue As-Needed Fire & Life Safety Systems, with Intelligent Technologies & Services, Inc.
items.text: Approve an increase of 219 calendar days (approximately seven months) to the duration contingency for Contract No. WD-2873(I), 525 Golden Gate Avenue As- Needed Fire & Life Safety Systems, with Intelligent Technologies & Services, Inc., for a revised duration limit of up to 1,825 consecutive calendar days (five years), to continue to perform inspections, testing, maintenance, repairs, and replacement of the fire and life safety systems as required, with no change to the contract contingency amount

items.title: Award Contract No. WD-2875, 8-Inch and 12-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main and Sewer Replacement on Grand View Avenue to Basset Engineering Inc., in the amount of $10,145,959
items.text: Award Contract No. WD-2875, 8-Inch and 12-Inch Ductile Iron Water Main and Sewer Replacement on Grand View Avenue from Clipper Street to Romain Street, and Various Area Streets, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Basset Engineering Inc., in the amount of $10,145,959 and with a duration of 640 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and nine months), to install water mains in the Noe Valley District of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision on this action. President Stacy stated for the record that she lives in the area where the work will take place, she does not have a conflict of interest due to the repair and maintenance of existing utility systems, and she can act impartially in the best interest of the City and vote on this item
